question: What happens when you press F5 in MS PowerPoint 2019?

options.text: Starts the slide show from the beginning

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Starts the slide show from the beginning**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pressing **F5** in **MS PowerPoint 2019** starts the **Slide Show** from the very first slide.
 
• The **Slide Show feature** is used to present a sequence of slides to an audience in a full-screen mode.
 
• This shortcut is widely used during **presentations** to instantly begin the slideshow without navigating through menus.
 
• The feature is especially helpful for **teachers, corporate professionals, and students** to deliver organized and visually appealing content.
 
• When the **F5 key** is pressed, PowerPoint transitions into **presentation mode**, displaying slides as designed.
 
• The function ensures that the presentation starts from slide one, making it ideal for **formal and structured demonstrations.**
 
• This shortcut is part of the **keyboard shortcuts** available in Microsoft Office applications to enhance user productivity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Opens the 'Print' dialog box**__

 __
 
• This action is performed by pressing **Ctrl + P** in **MS PowerPoint**.
 
• The Print dialog box allows users to configure printing options such as **number of copies, printer selection, and layout settings.**
 
 
 
• **Inserts a new slide**__
 __
 
• To insert a new slide, the shortcut key is **Ctrl + M**.
 
• This function is used to add slides during the editing phase of a presentation.
 
 
 
• **Saves the presentation**__
 
 
• Pressing **Ctrl + S** saves the presentation in PowerPoint.
 
• Saving ensures that no data is lost and allows users to keep their work updated.
